# algizian_service_account (Resource)

A machine identity of an organization. Its credential (see `algizian_service_account_token`) keeps working when people leave. Creating one needs an org admin token or a platform token, not a service account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algizian_service_account" "ci" {
  name = "ci"
  role = "admin"
  tags = { system = "github-actions" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1 to 80 characters.
- `role` (String) `admin` (limited: never creates tokens, service accounts or changes the owner) or `read`.

### Optional

- `org` (String) Organization slug; defaults to the provider `org`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Free labels (at most 20; keys start with a letter and use `a-z 0-9 . _ : -`, values up to 256 characters). Algizian never reads them. The map replaces the object's tags as a whole; set `{}` to clear them.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <org>/<service account id>
terraform import algizian_service_account.ci acme/sa_abc123
```
